title: UTN FRSN - Superior Technician in Programming
description: This year, I graduated from this program, where I learned everything from the basics of C++ to building REST APIs with ASP.NET and C# using SQL Server, as well as frontend development with React.

title: Ecommerce for 'Padel Point'
description: This is my first experience in a real-world environment. In this case, I was hired by a client to create an e-commerce platform for their sports product business. I developed the backend of a full-stack project while a colleague handled the frontend. We used essential technologies such as Next.js for the client-side and Nest.js for the backend, along with cloud services like OAuth clients, database deployment, and more.

title: Freelance WordPress Developer
description: This was my first remote experience working for an international client. I was hired by a startup based in Spain to develop websites as a freelance WordPress developer. Using templates, I built course sales pages, landing pages, and business websites with WooCommerce integration, among others.

title: Codescript | Fullstack Developer
description: My first opportunity to be part of a fully remote company. I worked on the backend, collaborating with a team to build an application for a logistics company in Mexico. We developed an API with a microservices architecture applying Domain-Driven Design and CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) with Nest.js, WebSockets, RabbitMQ, and OpenTelemetry, following the SCRUM methodology in Azure DevOps.

title: QUANTIA Ingeniería y Consultoría | Fullstack Developer
description: This is the company I currently work for, and where I've spent the longest time in my career so far. I work as a Fullstack Developer across several projects using the React, Nest.js, and Prisma stack, both on projects where I collaborate directly with the client on a daily basis and on internal projects within the organization.
